about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Who I am
about.text1: Junior Web Developer, recently graduated in Computer Science, Software Engineering track. I build modern web and mobile applications and have hands-on experience in frontend, backend, databases, REST APIs, UI/UX design and containerization.
about.text2: Curious, autonomous and passionate about new technologies, I am looking for a professional opportunity to contribute to real projects and keep improving.

allmada.title: AllMada — E-commerce Marketplace
allmada.description: Final-year project: design and development of a Malagasy web and mobile marketplace with an architecture close to professional e-commerce platforms. Dual administration: a platform administrator supervises the marketplace, while each seller has their own shop to manage products, orders and activities.
